en.headline: Government gazettes water recreation and yacht bay works near airport
en.dek: Proposed works by the Airport Authority in the bay between the airport, the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port and Tung Chung aim to create leisure and tourism facilities, with construction tentatively from 2027 to 2030.
body: The Government on Friday gazetted a notice proposing to allow the Airport Authority Hong Kong to carry out works for water recreation and yacht bay development in the bay area between Hong Kong International Airport, the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge Hong Kong Port and Tung Chung, including areas east of the port and in Tung Chung East.

The proposed works include dredging, construction of breakwaters, gangways, platforms and floating walkways for berthing and mooring, as well as cable wake towers and platforms for a water park facility. The aim is to create a diverse range of leisure and tourism opportunities and develop a marine lifestyle destination for residents and visitors.

Works are tentatively scheduled to start in 2027 and finish by 2030. Anyone who considers they have an interest, right or easement over the foreshore and seabed may lodge a written objection with the Director of Lands within two months, by 7 October.

zh.headline: 政府刊憲機場附近水上康樂及遊艇港灣工程
zh.dek: 機管局擬於機場、港珠澳大橋香港口岸與東涌之間海灣進行水上康樂及遊艇港灣發展工程，暫訂2027年展開、2030年完成。
body: 政府周五刊憲，擬准許香港機場管理局在香港國際機場、港珠澳大橋香港口岸與東涌之間的海灣，包括口岸以東及東涌東一帶，進行水上康樂及遊艇港灣發展工程。
擬議工程包括疏浚、建造防波堤、舷梯、平台及浮動行人通道作停泊及繫泊設施，以及建造繩索滑水塔、浮動行人通道及平台作水上樂園設施，旨在創造多元休閒及旅遊機會，發展供市民及遊客享用的海上生活目的地。
工程暫訂於2027年展開，2030年完成。任何人如認為對有關前濱及海床擁有權益、權利或地役權，可於刊憲日起計兩個月內，即10月7日或之前，以書面形式向地政總署署長提出反對。
